g.text: Cheapest checks first. No single layer is trusted alone; the real defense is that the Builder has few powers and every power goes through the executor.
new prompt with a key → rejected,
deny sudo, kill, rm -rf /, curl | sh,
file with a secret pattern → rejected
the last 200 chars so a key split
one chance for the Builder to fix
Example — what each layer does with one dangerous prompt
"build a site, my key is sk-live-…"
rejected by secret detection before a row is written
"a login page that looks like my bank"
classifier → block (phishing); free; GuardEvent with hash only
allow; parallel_search offered (≤ 6); results wrapped as untrusted
command guard refuses; the model is told why
Vibe's own keys (E2B, AI Gateway, Stripe, Inngest, GitHub tokens) never enter a sandbox, the model context, a realtime payload or a log.
